prompts.title: Swim
prompts.desktop: Use WASD or the arrow keys, or hold the mouse button to swim toward the cursor.
prompts.touch: Touch and drag on the left of the screen to swim.

prompts.title: Dash
prompts.desktop: Press Z, Shift or Enter, or right-click, for a burst of speed.
prompts.touch: Tap the Dash button for a burst of speed.

prompts.title: Bomb the floor
prompts.desktop: This floor is in the way. Swim over it and drop or throw a bomb onto it: Space or X throws it the way you swim, middle-click throws it at the cursor. Bombs sink, so aim down. Then swim away, the blast hurts you too.
prompts.touch: This floor is in the way. Swim over it and tap Bomb to drop one (bombs sink, so point the stick down), then swim away: the blast hurts you too.

prompts.title: The exit
prompts.desktop: Swim into the glowing ring to finish the tutorial.
prompts.touch: Swim into the glowing ring to finish the tutorial.
